meta.source: Club green from the Hough Green Bowls redesign (direction A) and the website design document. Version 2 replaced cream and brass with a cool green-tinted neutral and a fresh green highlight; version 3 sets everything in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for legibility.

color.note: Light only. Club green carries the identity; the page is a cool near-white tinted toward that green, never cream. Turf, a fresh light green, is the one highlight and lives on club green. Status colours are for the admin area only.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground on every public and admin page: a cool near-white tinted toward club green.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, FAQ items, admin rows, form fields and the editor: a hair lighter than the page. The system never uses pure white.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Grouping fill: the alternate section band (Club news, Membership), the address block, callouts, the editor toolbar, outline-button hover. Never a card on a card.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text on background (15.3:1), card and secondary (14.1:1).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Helper text, event times and places, captions, card blurbs. 6.7:1 on background, 6.2:1 on secondary, 7.1:1 on card. The floor for secondary text.

tokens.name: meta-foreground
tokens.usage: Fresh green text for dates and the meta line on news cards and posts, on light grounds only. 5.8:1 on background.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Club green. Header, hero, footer, the filled primary button, headings and links on light grounds (11.4:1 on background).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons (a step lighter than club green) and hover colour for links.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (11.4:1) and on primary-hover (8.1:1).

tokens.name: primary-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on primary: hero lede, footer details, the signed-in line in the admin bar. 8.3:1.

tokens.name: primary-border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline and hover underline on primary. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Turf. On primary only: the Join us button fill, the current-page underline, the roundel, the date tile weekday, outline-button edges on green, the undo timer. 8.3:1 on primary. Never on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Club green text on an accent fill (8.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Structural edges that carry no meaning: card and row edges, event list rules. Decorative only; interactive edges use input.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form field and toolbar control edges. 4.1:1 on card, 3.9:1 on background, 3.6:1 on secondary: the 3:1 boundary rule.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring on light grounds: 3px solid, 2px offset. 11.4:1 on background.

tokens.name: ring-on-primary
tokens.usage: The focus ring on primary grounds (header, hero, footer, the contact form): 3px solid, 2px offset. 8.3:1 on primary.

tokens.name: affirmative
tokens.usage: Admin status fill for Published, always with the word and a check icon.

tokens.name: affirmative-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on affirmative (10.5:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Admin status fill for Draft and unsaved changes, always with the word and a pencil icon.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning (6.6:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Fill for neutral admin notices such as 'Events come from Google Calendar'.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on info (7.1:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions and field errors: outline-button text and edge, error text and field edge. 7.0:1 on background, 7.4:1 on card.

tokens.name: destructive-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a page-level error and the destructive button hover. Text on it is destructive (6.1:1).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button or field. Never opacity.

tokens.name: disabled-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and edge of a disabled control (3.6:1 on disabled, 4.1:1 on background).

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 600 above 18px, 500 at 18px. Headings are club green on light grounds. No tracking: the face is spaced for legibility, so leave it as drawn.

styles.name: heading-hero
styles.sample: Bowls in the heart of Hough Green Park
styles.usage: The one h1 in a hero, once per page. Steps down to 36px / 44px below 768px.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Section titles on public pages; page titles in the admin area.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Post subheads, the contact form title, the date tile numeral, prices.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: The workhorse: event, news card, step and tier titles, FAQ questions, admin post titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: The wordmark and small group titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400 for reading, 500 for labels and meta. Designed by the Braille Institute so similar letters (I l 1, O 0, b d) are easy to tell apart. Body is 18px because many members are older: nothing smaller than 16px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A friendly club for bowlers of all ages and abilities.
styles.usage: Hero ledes and the Find us paragraph. Cap at 40ch.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Complete beginner or seasoned bowler, you'll fit right in.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: The green opens for the season on the first Saturday in April.
styles.usage: The body of a news post and the editor, inside the 720px measure.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Helper text, footer details, captions, admin meta. The smallest text in the system.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, field labels, back links.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates and the meta line on news cards and posts, in meta-foreground. Sentence case.

spacing.note: 4px base: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32 and 48px, plus 64px for public section padding. In Tailwind these are the default 4px steps (p-4 is 16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text in a badge, label to helper text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field, icon to text in a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field inner padding, gaps in a button row, admin row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between fields, header vertical padding, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Event row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Container side gutter, card padding, title to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid and between split columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the halves of the hero and Find us splits.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a public page section (48px on phones).

radius.note: Curved rectangles, capped at 12px. No pills, no circles in UI. Nested corners reduce concentrically.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, thumbnails inside a row.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, the date tile, step numbers, callouts, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the hero photo, the contact form, green panels. The cap.

layout.note: Widths and sizes shared by every page.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of header, footer and section content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a news post body and other long-form text.

tokens.name: form-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a standalone form.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything you can tap.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Outline buttons and form field edges. Structural edges stay 1px.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness, with a 2px offset.
